priorities.summary: OAuth2 SSRF in the SAP Cloud SDK for Python (before 0.45.2): an attacker controlling the tenant_subdomain parameter can redirect OAuth2 token requests to an attacker-controlled server, exfiltrating client credentials from multi-tenant BTP apps with no login required.

NVIDIA AIStore (Linux) legacy ETL Kubernetes PodSpec initialization API lets a remote attacker supply Kubernetes host-namespace and container-security settings, enabling code execution, privilege escalation, and data tampering across the AIStore storage layer.

Improper certificate validation in Microsoft Partner Center lets an unauthorized attacker elevate privileges over the network (October 2026 Patch Tuesday). Affects a broadly-deployed Microsoft partner management service.

model.name: Gemini 4 Argon
model.summary: Google's new flagship frontier model, now globally available via the Gemini API, AI Studio, and AI Mode in Search. Built for "deep work" — complex multi-step tasks across coding, finance, law, cybersecurity, and science — it launches at an introductory $2/$10 per million input/output tokens, doubling after Nov 30.
